patches.summary: Added SQLite-backed local store (internal/store/store.go) using modernc.org/sqlite for offline novel features.
patches.reason: The generated file cache (internal/cache/cache.go) is read-only and too simple for the 14 novel commands that need FTS5, session tracking, credit accounting, and cross-command data sharing.

patches.summary: Patched promoted_web.go to persist each live search call to the local SQLite store after API success.
patches.reason: Novel offline features (local-search, drift-detect, corpus gaps, sources-rank, budget-watch, replay) all depend on having prior search results stored locally. Without this hook, the store stays empty.
patches.validated_outcome: After 'web' calls, store.FTSSearch() finds matches; local-search returns results; corpus gaps reports unextracted URLs.

patches.summary: Patched promoted_extract.go to persist each live extract call to the local SQLite store after API success.
patches.reason: freshness-check and corpus gaps need the extraction history to compute stale/missing URLs.

patches.summary: Changed freshness-check --older-than from DurationVar (rejects '7d') to StringVar with custom parseFreshnessDuration helper.
patches.reason: Go's time.ParseDuration does not support the 'd' (days) suffix. Users naturally write '7d', '30d' etc. The generated DurationVar flag silently rejected these with a confusing parse error.
patches.validated_outcome: freshness-check --older-than 7d outputs 'No pages older than 168h0m0s found in cache.' instead of flag parse error.

patches.summary: Added 14 novel transcendence commands wired in root.go: qna, context, local-search, corpus (build+gaps), drift-detect, budget-watch, cost-report, batch-plan, replay, freshness-check, crawl-resume, research-track, sources-rank.
patches.reason: These commands leverage the SQLite store to provide capabilities unavailable in any other Tavily client: offline FTS, credit budget management, RAG corpus building, session-based agent replay, and cache freshness management.
